title: Demurrage and Detention Free Time: free days on each clock by product
content:
## Scope

This quick reference covers the free days granted under each of the six Aurelia Hanse Line (AHL) products of the Demurrage and Detention Free Time category. Free days are counted in whole calendar days and belong to one clock of one per-container record.

## Free days per product

| Product | Import demurrage | Import detention | Export detention | Export demurrage | Merged import clock | Merged export clock |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| AHL Tariff Free Time | 4 | 4 | 5 | 5 | 0 | 0 |
| AHL Free Time Extension 3 | 7 | 7 | 8 | 8 | 0 | 0 |
| AHL Free Time Extension 7 | 11 | 11 | 12 | 12 | 0 | 0 |
| AHL Combined Free Time 14 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 14 | 14 |
| AHL Combined Free Time 21 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 21 | 21 |
| AHL Contract Free Time 30 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 30 | 30 |

## What each column means

- **Import demurrage**: free days on the import demurrage clock, which runs from discharge to full gate-out.
- **Import detention**: free days on the import detention clock, which runs from full gate-out to empty return.
- **Export detention**: free days on the export detention clock, which runs from empty pickup to full gate-in.
- **Export demurrage**: free days on the export demurrage clock, which runs from full gate-in to loading.
- **Merged import clock**: free days on the single import clock, which runs from discharge to empty return.
- **Merged export clock**: free days on the single export clock, which runs from empty pickup to loading.

The four separate-clock columns are used only for a product whose clock model is separate; the two merged-clock columns are used only for a product whose clock model is combined. A zero in a column therefore marks a clock the product does not run, not a clock without free time.

## Points of judgement

**Q: How many free days does an export detention clock have under AHL Free Time Extension 7?**
A: 12 calendar days.

**Q: A consignee holds an import container on AHL Combined Free Time 21. Does it have separate demurrage and detention free days?**
A: No. Its separate-clock columns are 0 and its merged import clock carries 21 free days.

**Q: Under AHL Tariff Free Time, is the import allowance the same on both clocks?**
A: Yes. The import demurrage clock and the import detention clock each carry 4 free days; the export clocks each carry 5.
